# add import function

Add an `import` helper that sources a library file by a path relative to the repository (or to the calling script) rather than to the current directory:

```bash
$ import lib/some/bin.sh
# source $(root)/lib/some/bin.sh
```

Scripts in `bin/` that want a function from `bin/lib` need a location-independent way to load it; `source ../lib/x.bash` depends on `$PWD`.

<!-- 2026-09-16T05:49Z https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/issues/244#issuecomment-5711692115
Note: `bin/import` has no remaining consumer (`bin/new/clone` was removed in 2023); it resolves paths relative to `bin/`, not to the calling script, which the ticket's `$(root)` sketch implied.
-->
